method: Assistant inspection of all six original-resolution artifact PNGs using view_image
findings: The original bloodstream intro and cell assets render without missing-material panels or a blank screen.
The complete original intro caption is legible in light paper-colored type over the vessel scene.
The original CAP dialogue, speaker label, ink icon and Continue control fit and remain legible at1440 by900.
The dialogue, keyboard hint and Continue control fit at960 by600 without clipping or overlap.
Later captures show the original scene after actual dialogue keyboard input and viewport resizing.
scope: Current production release intro/dialogue and960 by600 viewport visual review only.
limitations: The immediate01-original-start frame records Unity’s splash; the separate production-phone run captures the actual visible Start card after splash completion.
This does not certify the full route, task HUD, menus, activities, continuous crowd behavior, free gameplay camera, audio, physical devices, performance or human difficulty.
Exact cell placement and animation timing differ between engines.
Startup NavMesh/GPU warnings remain in acceptance.json; this is not a zero-warning runtime claim.
2 known loader cancellations are retained; cancelled streams are not called successful downloads.
